theater: 北高加索車臣地區與格羅茲尼

battle.name: 第一次車臣戰爭
battle.theater: 北高加索車臣地區與格羅茲尼
battle.brief: 一九九四年十二月十一日，聯邦軍自北、西、東三面攻入車臣，圍困格羅茲尼，戰事延續至一九九六年八月。卡面的T-72主力戰車是聯邦軍機械化步兵旅的突擊骨幹，負責正面突破與掩護步兵，卻也在山區與巷戰中屢遭反戰車伏擊，數百輛被擊毀或繳獲，成為這場戰爭最具爭議的裝備符號。

kit.name: T-72主力戰車
kit.history: T-72是蘇聯於1970年代研製的主力戰車，具備120毫米滑膛炮與複合裝甲，成為俄軍機械化步兵師的核心突擊力量，至今仍在多國服役。

countries: 交戰的一方是俄羅斯聯邦，實際投入的是所謂「聯邦部隊聯合集群」：國防部第58集團軍與第29集團軍所屬部隊、北高加索軍區各兵團，內務部內務部隊（OMON與SOBR），邊防部隊，以及聯邦反情報局（時稱FSK，後改組為FSB）直屬的阿爾法、維佳茲等特種分隊。集群的指揮系統以北高加索軍區司令部為核心，參謀序列裡分設航空兵、傘兵、總參謀部情報總局與海軍作戰組；作戰地域內的核心裝備是T-72與T-80坦克，步兵戰車BMP-1、BMP-2，裝甲輸送車BTR-60、BTR-70，以及2S3「向日葵」與2S19「Msta-S」自行榴彈炮。另一方是未獲國際承認的車臣共和國伊奇克里亞武裝：以武裝民兵、車臣內務部隊殘餘與蘇軍散兵為骨幹，杜達耶夫以總統兼武裝部隊總司令身分統率，參謀長馬什哈多夫、內政部長、保安局長伊斯梅洛夫、地方指揮官蓋拉耶夫與巴巴耶夫各領一部，外籍武裝隊伍則由哈塔卜率領在阿爾古恩峽谷一線活動。俄方還扶植了第三股力量：反對杜達耶夫的一派武裝在九四年夏天起於北高加索大打，替莫斯科消耗車臣的骨幹兵力。海上一線同樣有布置：裏海艦隊自九一年起在西北岸執行封鎖與巡邏，但全程未正面投入地面戰。聯合國安理會自始至終未對用兵作出授權，衝突因此長期處於沒有國際法框架的灰色地帶。
countriesEn: One side was the Russian Federation, which committed what was formally called the Joint Grouping of Federal Forces: formations of the 58th Army and the 29th Army under the Ministry of Defence together with the formations of the North Caucasus Military District, the Interior Troops of the Ministry of Internal Affairs (OMON and SOBR), the Border Troops, and the special detachments of the Federal Security Service (still FSK at the time, later reorganised as the FSB), among them the Alpha and Vityaz groups. The command system of the grouping was built on the staff of the North Caucasus Military District, and its order of battle contained operational groups for the air force, the airborne troops, the Main Intelligence Directorate of the General Staff and the navy. The core equipment in the theatre was made up of T-72 and T-80 tanks, BMP-1 and BMP-2 infantry fighting vehicles, BTR-60 and BTR-70 armoured personnel carriers, and the 2S3 Akatsiya and 2S19 Msta-S self-propelled howitzers. The other side was the armed forces of the unrecognised Chechen Republic of Ichkeria: built on armed militia, the remnants of the Chechen interior troops and scattered regular army soldiers, and commanded by Dzhokhar Dudayev in his capacity of president and commander-in-chief of the armed forces, with the chief of staff Aslan Maskhadov, the interior minister, the head of the security service Aslanbek Ismailov, and the field commanders Ruslan Gelayev and Shamil Basayev each commanding a part of them, joined by foreign fighters led by Khattab who operated in the Argun Gorge. Moscow also backed a third force: armed groups opposed to Dudayev fought a war of their own across the North Caucasus from the summer of 1994, wearing out the Chechen cadres on the government's behalf. There was a disposition on the sea as well: from 1991 the Caspian Flotilla enforced a blockade and patrolled the north-western shore, but it never entered the ground battle. The United Nations Security Council never authorised the use of force, so the conflict remained for years in a grey zone without an international legal framework.
people: 決策分在莫斯科與格羅茲尼兩端。葉爾欽於一九九四年十一月三十日簽署第2137號秘密命令，授權以「恢復憲法秩序」的名義用兵，又在十二月十一日越境當日把這一仗說成送給畢業生的禮物；國防部長格拉喬夫隨即在十二月一日於邊境組建集群，卻聲稱一個空降團、二十天就能收場。首任集群司令、北高加索軍區司令米秋欣在戰役全面展開時被撤，第一副總司令沃羅比約夫以「毫無準備」為由拒絕接任並遞交辭職報告，十二月二十日由克瓦什寧接掌聯邦軍全局；真正主導格羅茲尼巷戰的是內政部長庫利科夫，他事後公開指參謀部把同一天陣亡的四十人報成十五人；沃羅比約夫一九九五年一月七日轉移指揮所時遭炮擊陣亡，是最早陣亡的將領之一。一九九五年十月六日集群司令羅馬諾夫在爆炸中重傷，攻勢為之一滯；一九九六年八月十九日普利科夫斯基的最後通牒被總統特使列別德譏為壞玩笑，八月三十一日列別德與馬什哈多夫簽下哈薩尤爾特協議。車臣一方，總統杜達耶夫是蘇聯空軍出身，曾在格羅茲尼被包圍時喊出「開火吧，你們打不死我，我繳械」；他於一九九六年四月二十一日被導彈擊中身亡。參謀長馬什哈多夫策劃了八月六日的反攻並在月末簽署協議，一九九七年一月當選伊奇克里亞總統；巴巴耶夫守沙托伊與韋杰諾一線，蓋拉耶夫死守鄉鎮陣地，伊斯梅洛夫一九九四年帶安全局人馬與總統衛隊倒向莫斯科，日後的車臣總統馬戈梅德·卡德羅夫當時在海關系統任職。士兵母親委員會則長期追問陣亡數字，構成日後軍改的輿論壓力。
peopleEn: The decisions were taken in two places, Moscow and Grozny. On 30 November 1994 Boris Yeltsin signed secret decree No. 2137, authorising the use of arms in the name of restoring constitutional legality, and on 11 December, the day of the crossing, he described the campaign as a graduation present. The defence minister Pavel Grachev assembled the grouping at the border on 1 December while claiming that a single airborne regiment and twenty days would be enough to finish the job. The first commander of the Joint Grouping, Colonel-General Anatoly Mityukhin of the North Caucasus Military District, was removed as the campaign unfolded; the first deputy commander-in-chief of the ground forces, Eduard Vorobyov, declined to take command on the grounds that the operation was wholly unprepared and tendered his resignation instead, and on 20 December Anatoly Kvashnin took over the federal side; the man who actually directed the street fighting in Grozny was the interior minister Anatoly Kulikov, who said afterwards in public that the staff had reported fifteen men killed on a single day when the true figure was forty. Vorobyov was killed by mortar fire while shifting his command post on 7 January 1995, one of the first generals to die. On 6 October 1995 the grouping commander, General Romanov, was critically wounded in an explosion and the offensive stalled. On 19 August 1996 the ultimatum of General Pulikovsky was dismissed by the presidential envoy Lebed as a bad joke, and on 31 August Lebed and Maskhadov signed the Khasavyurt Accord. On the Chechen side President Dzhokhar Dudayev, who had come out of the Soviet air force, once shouted from besieged Grozny that they should shoot, that they would not kill him because he was surrendering; he was killed by a missile strike on 21 April 1996. The chief of staff Aslan Maskhadov planned the counter-offensive of 6 August and signed the accord at the end of that month, and was elected president of Ichkeria in January 1997; Shamil Basayev held the Shatoy and Vedeno lines, Ruslan Gelayev clung to the villages and their field positions, and Aslanbek Ismailov turned the security service and the presidential guard over to Moscow in 1994. Magomed Kadyrov, who would later become president of Chechnya, was then working in the customs service. The soldiers' mothers' committees kept pressing the question of the dead, which formed the public pressure behind the later reform of the armed forces.
kits: 卡面是T-72主力戰車：一九七〇年代問世的蘇聯主戰坦克，配一二〇毫米滑膛炮（早期型配一二二毫米D-25T，後期型換裝2A46滑膛炮）、複合裝甲加「接觸-1」反應裝甲，V-46-6型七百八十馬力柴油機，公路時速約六十公里、越野時速約四十公里，總產量逾兩萬五千輛，是世界上產量最多的主戰坦克之一。在這場戰爭裡它同時是聯邦軍的突擊骨幹與最脆弱的目標：一九九四年十二月十一日越境的三個集群編制中，全軍只有八十輛坦克；到了格羅茲尼巷戰階段，湧入街區的裝甲車約二百五十輛，T-72與T-80夾雜在BMP-1、BMP-2之間，狹窄街道與樓房間距讓它們無法展開射界，步兵與坦克的協同迅速瓦解。聯邦軍改以炮兵與航空兵逐段清剿，T-72多數時候只是停在街角當作射擊平台；一九九五年一月二十六日有坦克乘員在沒有步兵掩護下拒絕繼續推進工業區，反戰車小組與地雷則是它最主要的損失原因：一九九五年一月一日強攻格羅茲尼時，第131獨立摩托化步兵旅作戰地域內有二十輛坦克被毀，旅長薩文上校陣亡。車臣方面同樣大量使用反戰車手段，RPG-7、RPG-16與AT-3「薩格」反戰車導彈在峽谷與路口埋伏，配合密集地雷，收割縱隊首尾；被擊毀的殘骸與繳獲的完整車輛同樣被吸收，據車臣方面的軍事回憶錄統計，這場戰爭中車臣武裝繳獲或接收的蘇聯系坦克約二百七十輛、卡車逾兩千輛，多數是封存的T-72與T-80，這批車在九九年第二次車臣戰爭開打時被大量啟用。除裝甲兵器外，聯邦軍投入Mi-24「鱷魚」武裝直升機、Su-24與Su-25飛機、2S3與2S19自行榴彈炮、BM-21「冰雹」火箭炮，車臣方以AKM、AK-74、PKM、DShK與改裝卡車為骨架，砲兵湊合繳獲的榴彈炮與冰雹火箭炮，射表幾乎全靠臨場估算；TOS-1A溫壓火箭炮亦在九六年的城市攻堅中投入，同年二月二十六日聯邦軍突入格羅茲尼的縱隊還試圖以RPG-7加裝熱壓彈頭開路。
kitsEn: The card shows the T-72 main battle tank: a Soviet main battle tank developed in the 1970s, with a 120 mm smoothbore gun (early models carrying the 122 mm D-25T, later types re-equipped with the 2A46 smoothbore), composite armour with Kontakt-1 explosive reactive armour, the V-46-6 diesel engine of 780 horsepower, a road speed of about 60 km/h and a cross-country speed of about 40 km/h, and a total production of more than 25,000 vehicles, making it one of the most numerous main battle tanks in the world. In this war it was at once the shock arm of the federal forces and their most vulnerable target: when the three groupings crossed the border on 11 December 1994 the entire federal force had only 80 tanks; by the street fighting in Grozny some 250 armoured vehicles had pushed into the built-up area, with T-72s and T-80s mixed in among BMP-1s and BMP-2s, and the narrow streets and the spacing between buildings left the tanks unable to deploy their fire arcs, so the cooperation between armour and infantry broke down within days. The federal side fell back on artillery and aircraft to clear the city block by block, and the T-72 was most of the time little more than a firing platform parked at a corner; on 26 January 1995 tank crews refused to continue into the industrial district without infantry support, and anti-tank teams and mines were the main source of its losses: in the assault on Grozny of 1 January 1995 twenty tanks were destroyed in the sector of the 131st Separate Motor Rifle Brigade, whose commander Colonel Savin was killed. The Chechen side used anti-tank methods on a large scale as well, ambushes with RPG-7, RPG-16 and AT-3 Sagger guided missiles in gorges and at junctions, combined with dense minefields, cutting the head and tail off enemy columns; destroyed wrecks and captured intact vehicles were absorbed in turn, and according to the Chechen military memoirs some 270 Soviet tanks and more than 2,000 trucks were captured or received by the Chechen armed forces during the war, most of them stored T-72s and T-80s, and this stock was put back into service on a large scale when the second Chechen war opened in 1999. Beyond the armoured fighting, the federal side committed Mi-24 Hind attack helicopters, Su-24 and Su-25 aircraft, the 2S3 and 2S19 self-propelled howitzers and BM-21 Grad multiple rocket launchers, while the Chechens built their skeleton on AKM and AK-74 rifles, PKM and DShK machine guns and improvised trucks, and their artillery was made up of captured howitzers and Grad launchers whose firing tables were largely worked out on the spot; the TOS-1A thermobaric rocket launcher was also used in the urban assault of 1996, and in the column that entered Grozny on 26 February 1996 the federal side tried to lead with an RPG-7 fitted with a thermobaric warhead.
tactics: 聯邦軍的戰術主軸是三面縱深推進加合圍：西線自北奧塞梯亞經印古什向格羅茲尼推進，北線自莫茲多克沿捷列克河南下，東線自達吉斯坦的基茲利亞爾沿草原迂迴。一九九四年十二月十一日三個集群同時越境，十九日發動新攻勢，二十日莫茲多克集群佔領多林斯基，第104空降兵團從阿爾古恩峽谷方向封住城市北面；三十一日以「北」「東北」「西」「東」四個集群強攻格羅茲尼，一九九五年二月三日才組成「南」集群完成南面包圍，至二月九日推進到羅斯托夫—巴庫公路一線。巷戰裡約二百五十輛裝甲車湧入街區，狹窄街道讓坦克無法展開，步兵與坦克失去協同，遂改由炮兵與航空兵逐段清剿；山地則靠傘兵與特種部隊小組空降插入敵後，十二月三十一日在科姆索莫爾斯克與謝爾任-尤爾特兩地分別空降第22獨立特種旅與第67獨立特種旅的分隊，負責引導炮火、設伏破壞道路並佈雷。車臣方的做法是據點防禦加小組狙擊：據守火車站、總統府與蘇日阿河畔的分層工事，以RPG伏擊縱隊首尾，選擇道路與峽谷的狹窄處下手，一九九六年四月十六日在阿爾古恩峽谷的雅雷什馬爾迪村擊毀第245近衛摩托化步兵團縱隊的全部裝甲，半數人員折損。一九九五年春夏聯邦軍在南部山區節節推進，先取納馬克與阿爾漢-卡拉山頭，再奪格爾別利，車臣武裝則在同期以阿奇霍伊-馬爾坦山區為基地發動反攻，一度收復薩馬什基，逼聯邦軍退守公路，雙方在山裡的反覆拉鋸把這場戰爭拖成持久消耗。
tacticsEn: The federal plan was a deep advance on three axes combined with a blockade: the western column came from North Ossetia through Ingushetia towards Grozny, the northern column down the Terek from Mozdok, and the eastern column swung round through the Dagestan steppe from Kizlyar. On 11 December 1994 the three groupings crossed the border simultaneously, a new offensive began on the 19th, the Mozdok group took Dolinsky on the 20th, and the 104th Air Assault Regiment sealed the northern approach through the Argun Gorge; on 31 December the storm of Grozny went in with four groups named North, North-East, West and East, and only on 3 February 1995 was a South group formed to close the southern side, reaching the Rostov-Baku highway by 9 February. In the streets some 250 armoured vehicles pushed into the built-up area, where the narrow streets left the tanks unable to deploy and broke the cooperation between armour and infantry, so the fight was carried on instead by artillery and aircraft, block by block; in the mountains, spetsnaz groups were inserted behind enemy lines by air: on 31 December detachments of the 22nd and 67th Separate Special Purpose Brigades were airlifted in near Komsomolskoye and near Serzhen-Yurt, to spot for the artillery, ambush roads and blow them up, and lay mines. The Chechen method was a defence by strongpoints combined with attacks by small groups: layered positions held the railway station, the presidential palace and the banks of the Sunzha, RPG ambushes took the head and tail of columns, and strikes were made where roads and gorges narrowed; on 16 April 1996 at the village of Yaryashmaldi in the Argun Gorge they destroyed all the armour of a column of the 245th Guards Motor Rifle Regiment, at the cost of half its personnel. In the spring and summer of 1995 the federal forces advanced stage by stage in the southern mountains, taking the Namak and Alkhan-Kala heights and then Gergebil, while the Chechens launched a counter-offensive from the Achkhoy-Martan area, briefly retook Samashki and pushed the federal troops back to the roads, and the repeated seesaw in the hills turned the war into a war of attrition.
data: 可以確定的第一組數字是一九九四年十二月十一日越境時的編成：三個集群合計二萬三千八百人，其中國防部一萬九千一百人、內務部隊四千七百人，配八十輛坦克、二百零八輛步兵戰車與裝甲輸送車、一百八十二門火砲與迫擊砲、一百四十架作戰飛機、五十五架直升機；同一份編制在十二月投入的作戰飛機總數為五百一十五架，到一九九五年二月，全部部署兵力被統計為七萬零五百人。車臣武裝方面，一九九四年的估計在一萬三千五百至一萬五千人之間，十二月約二萬人，一九九五年一月一度被估為三萬人，二月回落至一萬五千至一萬七千人，到一九九六年八月俄方估計已達四萬人，而車臣自己的說法是六千人。作戰數字上，一九九五年一月一日強攻格羅茲尼時，第131獨立摩托化步兵旅作戰地區有八十五人陣亡、七十二人失蹤，二十輛坦克被毀，旅長薩文上校陣亡，百餘人被俘；一九九六年四月十六日阿爾古恩峽谷的伏擊戰中，第245近衛摩托化步兵團縱隊的裝甲全部損失，半數人員折損。俄軍全期損失，聯合集群作戰指揮部公布為陣亡四千一百零三人、失蹤逃亡與被俘合計一千二百三十一人、受傷一萬九千七百九十四人；軍事史家克里沃謝耶夫統計為陣亡五千零四十二人、失蹤六百九十人、受傷一萬七千八百九十二人；士兵母親委員會則主張陣亡人數不少於一萬四千人。車臣方面的陣亡數字有俄方公佈的一萬七千三百九十一人、內務部一九九五年十一月公佈的一萬至一萬五千人、紀念協會的兩千七百人與車臣自己的約三千人等版本。
dataEn: The first set of numbers that can be pinned down is the order of battle at the crossing of 11 December 1994: the three groupings together numbered 23,800 men, of whom 19,100 came from the armed forces and 4,700 from the Interior Troops, with 80 tanks, 208 infantry fighting vehicles and armoured personnel carriers, 182 guns and mortars, 140 combat aircraft and 55 helicopters; the same order of battle counted 515 combat aircraft in service in December 1994, and by February 1995 the total deployed force was reckoned at 70,500 men. On the Chechen side the estimates ran from 13,500 to 15,000 in 1994, about 20,000 in December 1994, were put as high as 30,000 in January 1995, fell back to between 15,000 and 17,000 in February 1995, and reached 40,000 by August 1996 according to the Russian side, while the Chechens themselves put the figure at 6,000. On the fighting itself, in the assault on Grozny of 1 January 1995 the 131st Separate Motor Rifle Brigade lost 85 men killed and 72 missing in its sector, twenty tanks were destroyed and its commander Colonel Savin was killed, with more than a hundred men taken prisoner; in the ambush of 16 April 1996 in the Argun Gorge a column of the 245th Guards Motor Rifle Regiment lost all its armour and half its personnel. For the whole campaign the joint operational directorate of the grouping published 4,103 killed, 1,231 missing, deserted or captured and 19,794 wounded; the military historian Krivosheev counted 5,042 killed, 690 missing and 17,892 wounded; the soldiers' mothers' committees maintained that no fewer than 14,000 had been killed. The Chechen dead are given in several versions: 17,391 published by the Russian side, 10,000 to 15,000 announced by the interior ministry in November 1995, 2,700 from the memorial association, and about 3,000 according to the Chechens themselves.
cause: 直接起因是蘇聯解體後車臣主權與獨立的宣示。一九九一年十月，車臣最高蘇維埃選舉前蘇聯空軍將軍杜達耶夫出任總統；一九九二年車臣宣佈主權，一九九三年正式宣佈獨立，成為車臣共和國伊奇克里亞。莫斯科起初並不打算立刻動武，反而在一九九三至一九九四年間資助反對派武裝向格羅茲尼進攻，一九九四年八月反對派一度攻入城內，外界以為杜達耶夫政權即將垮台，反而讓他撐過最危險的一關，同時消耗了車臣的骨幹。一九九四年十月與十一月二十六至二十七日的兩次進攻都告失敗，格羅茲尼的攻堅屢屢受挫。一九九三年十二月二十九日格羅茲尼市中心市場的轟炸事件把衝突推向不可收拾，一九九四年十一月二十九日葉爾欽發出最後通牒，三十日簽署第2137號秘密命令，十二月一日起對全境實施大規模空襲，十一日地面部隊越境。
causeEn: The immediate cause lay in the declaration of sovereignty and independence by Chechnya after the dissolution of the Soviet Union. In October 1991 Dzhokhar Dudayev, a former Soviet air force general, was elected president by the Supreme Soviet of Chechnya; in 1992 Chechnya declared sovereignty, and in 1993 full independence, becoming the Chechen Republic of Ichkeria. Moscow did not at first intend to resort to arms, and in 1993 and 1994 instead financed opposition armed groups against Grozny; in August 1994 the opposition entered the city, and the expectation that the Dudayev government was about to fall in fact let him survive his most dangerous moment while wearing out the Chechen cadres. The attempts of October 1994 and of 26 to 27 November 1994 both failed, and the repeated failures of the storming of Grozny wore the attackers down. The bombing of the central market in Grozny on 29 December 1993 pushed the conflict out of control; on 29 November 1994 Yeltsin issued his ultimatum, signed secret decree No. 2137 on the 30th, began massive air strikes across the republic on 1 December, and the ground forces crossed the border on the 11th.
impact: 戰爭的後果遠超出車臣本身。一九九五年春天聯邦軍控制了格羅茲尼與北部低地，但山地游擊戰一直延續到一九九六年，戰術勝利沒有換來政治成果：一九九六年八月六日車臣武裝發動「聖戰」行動，一千五百名武裝人員滲透格羅茲尼，奪回阿爾古恩與古傑爾梅斯，第276摩托化步兵團在兩日馳援中損失五成，聯邦軍用盡攻城手段仍未能奪回市中心。八月十九日普利科夫斯基的最後通牒被總統特使列別德譏為壞玩笑，八月三十一日簽署哈薩尤爾特協議，聯邦軍須在一九九六年十二月三十一日前全部撤出，車臣地位問題延至二〇〇一年再議。一九九七年五月十二日，葉爾欽與馬什哈多夫在莫斯科簽署和平條約，同年十一月雙方簽訂經濟關係與賠償協議，一九九七年二月俄方通過對雙方作戰人員的大赦。戰爭同樣暴露了聯邦軍的裝備與體制侷限：軍用通信未加密、城鎮地形下的裝甲與步兵協同失敗、飛機與火砲在城市裡的火力運用失控，這些教訓在此後的軍改中一一被重講。一九九六年十二月車臣武裝一度重奪格羅茲尼並向達吉斯坦進逼，引發聯邦政治危機與一場提前的總統選舉；一九九九年夏天第二場車臣戰爭爆發，一九九六年的協議被撕毀。
impactEn: The consequences of the war reached far beyond Chechnya itself. In the spring of 1995 the federal forces held Grozny and the northern lowlands, but the guerrilla war in the mountains ran on into 1996, and tactical victory brought no political result: on 6 August 1996 the Chechen armed forces launched Operation Jihad, some 1,500 fighters infiltrated Grozny, took Argun and Gudermes, and the 276th Motor Rifle Regiment lost half its strength in a two-day attempt to reach the city centre; the federal side failed to retake the centre of the capital even after every means of siege. The ultimatum of 19 August issued by Pulikovsky was dismissed by the presidential envoy Lebed as a bad joke, and on 31 August the Khasavyurt Accord was signed: all federal forces were to be withdrawn by 31 December 1996, and the status of Chechnya was deferred to 2001. On 12 May 1997 Yeltsin and Maskhadov signed the formal treaty in Moscow, in November of the same year the two sides concluded agreements on economic relations and reparations, and in February 1997 Russia approved an amnesty for Russian soldiers and Chechen fighters alike. The war exposed the limitations of the federal forces in equipment and organisation as well: military communications were not encrypted, armour and infantry failed to cooperate in built-up terrain, and the use of aircraft and artillery fire in a city went out of control; each of these lessons was re-read in the reform of the armed forces that followed. In December 1996 the Chechen armed forces briefly retook Grozny and pressed towards Dagestan, which triggered a political crisis in the federation and a presidential election brought forward; in the summer of 1999 the second Chechen war broke out and the accord of 1996 was torn up.
result: 結果是聯邦軍一九九五年三月控制格羅茲尼南區，四月十五日以縱隊長驅進入南部山區，五月先後拿下阿爾古恩與古傑爾梅斯，但清剿山區的努力在沙托伊、韋杰諾與達爾戈一線被拖住；一九九五年十月六日聯合集群司令羅馬諾夫在爆炸中重傷，攻勢整體停滯。一九九六年三月六日車臣武裝滲入格羅茲尼奪取軍火，四月十六日又在阿爾古恩峽谷打掉一個團的縱隊，六月十日納茲蘭會談達成撤軍框架。形勢逆轉的頂點是一九九六年八月六日的「聖戰」行動：車臣武裝一度奪回首都與兩個重要市鎮，聯邦軍損失慘重而無法逆轉，軍方情報被認為失準。八月十九日普利科夫斯基的最後通牒未果，葉爾欽的總統特使、退役上將列別德接手斡旋，八月三十一日與馬什哈多夫簽署哈薩尤爾特協議，聯邦軍一九九六年十二月三十一日前撤出，車臣地位延至二〇〇一年。一九九七年一月馬什哈多夫當選伊奇克里亞總統，五月和平條約簽署。多數研究把這場戰爭判為車臣的戰術勝利與俄羅斯的失敗：聯邦軍的目標——解除武裝、恢復聯邦管治——並未達成，聯邦軍付出的人命與裝備損耗遠高於換取到的政治成果，裝備上的教訓則在後續軍改裡被重新計算。
resultEn: The outcome was that federal forces took the southern part of Grozny in March 1995, drove in long columns into the southern mountains on 15 April and had taken Argun and Gudermes by May, but the attempt to clear the mountains was bogged down on the Shatoy, Vedeno and Dargo lines; on 6 October 1995 General Romanov, commander of the Joint Grouping, was critically wounded in an explosion and the offensive stalled as a whole. On 6 March 1996 Chechen fighters infiltrated Grozny and seized weapons caches, on 16 April they destroyed another regiment column in the Argun Gorge, and on 10 June the talks at Nazran produced a framework for withdrawal. The high point of the reversal was Operation Jihad of 6 August 1996: the Chechen armed forces briefly retook the capital and two important towns, the federal side took heavy losses and could not reverse the situation, and the military intelligence was judged to have misread the enemy. The ultimatum of 19 August issued by Pulikovsky produced nothing, and Yeltsin's presidential envoy, the retired general Lebed, took over the mediation, signing the Khasavyurt Accord with Maskhadov on 31 August: the federal forces would be out by 31 December 1996, and the status of Chechnya was deferred to 2001. In January 1997 Maskhadov was elected president of Ichkeria, and in May the peace treaty was signed. Most studies judge the war a tactical victory for the Chechens and a defeat for Russia: the federal objectives, disarming the separatists and restoring federal governance, were not achieved, the lives and the equipment the federal forces paid were far greater than the political result bought in return, and the lesson drawn from the equipment was recalculated in the reform of the armed forces that followed.
